label: AI-judged (GLM-5.3, blind) on SIMULATED learners; not real-learner proof

recs.subject: act
errors: 1: 'Most ACT algebra questions are multi-step equations' — unsupported overstatement; ACT algebra includes many single-step, substitution, function and word-problem items.
2: 'One chess problem, two attempts' labels a plain algebra equation as a chess problem (misleading framing; the mathematics itself is correct).
recs.objective_note: Both versions teach the stated objective — distribute, collect like terms, apply inverse operations, check — anchored on the same equation 2(x + 3) = 4x - 5; neither drifts from the topic.
